[quote][b]
[size=5]About[/size][/b]

An actress with a strange affinity to water and love of fishing. She's on the older side, living at the beach with her two kids, plus her best friend and his kid!
If you dig a little deeper, you might find a guitarist for a disbanded rock band looking strikingly familiar...

As a mother, and seemingly the only person who is capable of having a schedule in her family, don't be surprised to find her reminding the farmer on Tuesday that Pierre closes tomorrow, or when friendly enough, giving the farmer juice during the summer, even sharing some snacks at the end of the week! It's a cheat day after all~
If someone gives her a gift she adores, she always gives them something in return. It's simple courtesy, and she has more than enough money to spend.

Her children have allergies, so she will keep yours in mind too. The farmer has a finfish allergy? Some events will play out a little differently! (Don't worry! You won't really miss out, it mostly just keeps your farmer further away from the fishes, and gives slightly different flavor text!)

She isn't retired, she simply missed living near nature and the sea. Despite living so far away from the nearest city, she strangely doesn't seem to have any problems with travel.
Certain rumors mention her catching fish with her bare hands, and for a split second, the hand doesn't look quite right...[/quote]
[quote][b]
[size=5]Additional Information:[/size]
First name:[/b] Arumi

[b]Height:[/b] 198 cm / 6'6"[/quote]
[quote][b]
[size=5]Current Features[/size]﻿
﻿
She will sometimes give your farmer gifts when you talk to her![/b]

Give her a loved gift
Dumpster Dive
Complete the Community Center
Sometimes when you talk with her at 8 hearts![/spoiler]
- ﻿200+ Lines of Dialogue
- 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th Heart event

(The allergy only affects her interactions, not vanilla ones, but considering how much she fishes, I wanted to add it as an option. I may have missed some spots though, please let me know if you spot any!)[/quote]

[b][size=3]More are planned for almost every category! This is a heavy WIP, but considering it's my first "big" mod, I'm really proud of myself![/size]
[/b]

[quote][b]
[size=5]NPC Schedule[/size]﻿[/b]

[b]On rainy days[/b], if she's not home, you'll often find her fishing at the mountains or in Willy's store.

[b]During spring and fall:[/b]
- On Mondays, she will go shopping at Pierre's in the morning, then start walking to the Museum at 11:20 am, then return to the beach in the afternoon at 4:30 pm (16:30) before walking back home at 8:30 pm (20:30).
- On Tuesdays, you can find her at Pierre's with the other ladies, before leaving for the beach at 4:10 pm (16:10) and walking back home at 8:30 pm (20:30).
- On Wednesdays, she'll start walking towards Willy's at 8:20 am, then start walking to the Carpenter's at 11:00 am, then she starts walking home at 4:30 pm (16:30).
- On Thursdays, she'll start walking towards the museum at 8:20 am, and leaves to go fish on the Mountain at 12:30 pm (midday), she'll start walking home at 5:30 pm (17:30).
- On Fridays, she'll start walking towards the museum at 8:20 am, and leaves for the Saloon at 4:00 pm (16:00), she starts walking home at 7:00 pm (19:00).
- Saturday and Sunday is the same as Thursday!

[b]During summer and winter:[/b]
- On Mondays, she will go shopping at Pierre's in the morning, then start walking to the Mountain at 11:20 am, then return to the beach in the afternoon at 4:30 pm (16:30) before walking back home at 5:30 pm (17:30).
- On Tuesdays, you can find her at Pierre's with the other ladies, before leaving for the beach at 4:10 pm (16:10) and  walking back home at 8:30 pm (20:30).
- On Wednesdays,  she'll start walking towards Willy's at 7:50 am, then start walking to the Carpenter's at 10:00 am, and she goes to fish in the Mountain at 2 pm (14:00), then she starts walking home at 4:30 pm (16:30).
- On Thursdays, she'll start walking towards the museum at 7:50 am, and leaves to go fish on the Mountain at 12:00 pm (midday), she'll start walking home at 5:30 pm (17:30).
- On Fridays, she'll start walking towards the Mountain at 7:50 am, and leaves for the Saloon at 12:30 pm (midday), she starts walking home at 7:00 pm (19:00).

- Exclusively during Summer on Sundays, she will leave for the Mountain at 7:50 am, start walking towards Alex's ice cream stand at 1:00 pm (13:00), go to the Saloon at 5:00 pm (17:00), and start walking back home at 7:00 pm (19:00)

[b]During passive festivals:[/b]
- The first day of the Desert Festival she will arrive at 11:30 am, where she goes to stand by the pond on the top left. At 12:30 pm (midday) she will walk towards the Scholar, and then at 3:00 pm (15:00) she will move towards the bottom right of the race track.
- The second day of the Desert Festival she will arrive at 11:30 am to fish in the pond on the top left, then move down towards the food stand at 12:30 pm (midday), and at 3:00 pm (15:00) she will move down towards the bottom right of the race track.
- The third day of the Desert festival she will arrive at 11:30 am, and will stand by the pond in front of the entrance to Skull Caverns all day, where at 1:50 am (10 minutes before you pass out yes) she will move to enter Skull Caverns. (reasons why is in her dialogue.)

- Every day during the Trout Derby, she will leave her house at 7:50 am to fish in the Forest in front of the stand until 6:00 pm (18:00), when she starts walking home.
- Every day during Squidfest she will fish in front of her house from 7:50 am until 8:50 pm (20:50) where she goes back inside her house.

- First day of the Night Market she'll start walking towards the Mountain at 7:50 am, and moves to attend the Night Market at 1:50 pm (13:50) where she will stand beside the Traveling Merchant, she starts walking home at 8:30 pm (20:30).
- Second day of the Night Market she'll start walking towards the Museum at 7:50 am, and moves to attend the Night Market at 4:00 pm (16:00) where she will stand to the right of the submarine, she starts walking home at 8:30 pm (20:30).
- Third day of the Night Market she'll start walking towards the Mountain at 7:50 am, and moves to attend the Night Market at 1:50 pm (13:50) where she will stand in front of the shopkeeper to the right of the painter, she starts walking home at 8:30 pm (20:30).[/quote]

[b]Changes that could cause issues:[/b]
Other mods that changes which frames Willy's fishing animation uses
Other mods that has important changes in the square water area to the top left of the beach map. Changes to the path above and anything below is fine, and visual non-gameplay related changes like Gem Sea Shores should be fine too.

I try to use my Mod ID before every variable to avoid compatibility issues, which is why I didn't mention the other files I edited.
Let me know if you find any conflicts, and I will look into it, but there's no guarantee it'll be fixed. Especially if it's more complex and/or would require me to change my mod substantially.[/quote]
